page.title: Voices after abolition
page.lead: Recorded testimony from families who lived under, and left, the Kamaiya, Haliya and Haruwa-Charuwa systems, with transcripts in Nepali and English.
page.ethics: Recordings are published only with the narrator’s informed consent. Some names and places have been changed to protect narrators.
